reviewMethod: Individual reading and editorial assessment of each final prompt. Whole-catalogue exact, TF-IDF and LSA candidate retrieval informs semantic adjudication. AI provenance remains separate from human approval.
similarityAdjudication: Replaced the privacy/secrecy paraphrase of SM-010313 with a distinct caregiving and self-support question. Other lexical matches change the requested experience or decision: performance versus time apart, purpose of apology versus sincerity, generosity versus leadership, conduct in conflict versus learning achievement. Individually read the final copy and checked mood, topic, audience and safety. LSA retrieval is not claimed as exhaustive neural semantic proof.
